en-med-01.spoken: The patient presented to our emergency department with a three-day history of dyspnea and chest pain.

en-med-02.spoken: The ECG showed atrial fibrillation with a rapid ventricular response of 130 beats per minute.

en-med-03.spoken: We started anticoagulation with apixaban and achieved rate control with bisoprolol.

en-med-04.spoken: Laboratory studies showed a CRP of 85 and a leukocytosis with a white count of 14 per nanoliter.

en-med-05.spoken: The chest X-ray confirmed a right lower lobe pneumonia with an associated pleural effusion.

en-med-06.spoken: Empiric antibiotic therapy was given with piperacillin and tazobactam for seven days.

en-med-07.spoken: In known type 2 diabetes mellitus, the H B A 1 C remains above target.

en-med-08.spoken: We recommend adding empagliflozin to the existing metformin.

en-med-09.spoken: His hypertension is well controlled on ramipril and amlodipine.

en-med-10.spoken: Echocardiography revealed mildly reduced left ventricular systolic function.

en-med-11.spoken: The N T pro B N P was markedly elevated, consistent with decompensated heart failure.

en-med-12.spoken: Intravenous furosemide led to good diuresis with a weight loss of four kilograms.

en-med-13.spoken: Upper endoscopy demonstrated reflux esophagitis and erosive gastritis in the antrum.

en-med-14.spoken: We prescribed pantoprazole 40 milligrams once daily for eight weeks.

en-med-15.spoken: The rapid test for Helicobacter pylori was positive, so eradication therapy was initiated.

en-med-16.spoken: At colonoscopy, a two-centimeter polyp in the sigmoid colon was completely removed.

en-med-17.spoken: Histology showed a tubulovillous adenoma without evidence of malignancy.

en-med-18.spoken: She reports recurrent episodes of vertigo and one episode of syncope on standing.

en-med-19.spoken: A Holter monitor showed no significant arrhythmias and no pauses.

en-med-20.spoken: Thyroid function tests showed a suppressed TSH with an elevated free T4, consistent with hyperthyroidism.

en-med-21.spoken: We initiated antithyroid treatment with methimazole.

en-med-22.spoken: For hypothyroidism, the dose of levothyroxine was increased to 75 micrograms.

en-med-23.spoken: CT of the abdomen showed acute sigmoid diverticulitis without perforation.

en-med-24.spoken: Antibiotics were continued orally with ciprofloxacin and metronidazole.

en-med-25.spoken: Ultrasound showed cholelithiasis with a thickened gallbladder wall.

en-med-26.spoken: We recommend an elective laparoscopic cholecystectomy once she is symptom-free.

en-med-27.spoken: Lipase was five times the upper limit of normal, so we suspect acute pancreatitis.

en-med-28.spoken: Renal function is impaired with a creatinine of 2 and an e G F R of 35.

en-med-29.spoken: Given this renal insufficiency, metformin should be held and the sitagliptin dose reduced.

en-med-30.spoken: Potassium was 6, so spironolactone was discontinued.

en-med-31.spoken: Because a pulmonary embolism was suspected, a CT angiogram of the pulmonary arteries was performed.

en-med-32.spoken: The D-dimer was elevated, and duplex ultrasound confirmed a left deep vein thrombosis.

en-med-33.spoken: Therapeutic anticoagulation was started with enoxaparin and then switched to rivaroxaban.

en-med-34.spoken: The patient has GOLD stage 3 COPD with frequent exacerbations.

en-med-35.spoken: His inhaled therapy consists of tiotropium and formoterol, with albuterol as needed.

en-med-36.spoken: We gave prednisone 40 milligrams for five days without a taper.

en-med-37.spoken: Spirometry showed a moderate obstructive ventilatory defect.

en-med-38.spoken: She complains of paresthesias in both feet, consistent with diabetic polyneuropathy.

en-med-39.spoken: For the neuropathic pain we started pregabalin with gradual titration.

en-med-40.spoken: MRI of the brain showed acute ischemic lesions in the left middle cerebral artery territory.

en-med-41.spoken: After thrombolysis with alteplase, the right-sided hemiparesis partially resolved.

en-med-42.spoken: For secondary prevention he receives clopidogrel and atorvastatin 80 milligrams.

en-med-43.spoken: His Parkinson's disease medication with carbidopa and levodopa is continued unchanged.

en-med-44.spoken: She takes levetiracetam 500 milligrams twice daily for epilepsy.

en-med-45.spoken: The radiograph showed a displaced distal radius fracture on the right.

en-med-46.spoken: Open reduction and internal fixation with a volar plate was performed under a brachial plexus block.

en-med-47.spoken: For analgesia she received acetaminophen and oxycodone as needed.

en-med-48.spoken: Bone densitometry showed osteoporosis, and we recommend alendronate and cholecalciferol.

en-med-49.spoken: The complete blood count showed iron deficiency anemia with a hemoglobin of 9 and a low ferritin.

en-med-50.spoken: We gave intravenous ferric carboxymaltose and scheduled an upper endoscopy for further workup.

en-med-51.spoken: She has recurrent major depressive disorder and takes escitalopram and mirtazapine.

en-med-52.spoken: For nighttime agitation related to dementia he receives low-dose quetiapine.

en-med-53.spoken: The urinary tract infection was treated with a single dose of fosfomycin.

en-med-54.spoken: Pyelonephritis was suspected, and the urine culture grew Escherichia coli.

en-med-55.spoken: Serial troponins were negative, making an acute coronary syndrome unlikely.

en-med-56.spoken: Cardiac catheterization revealed a significant stenosis of the left anterior descending artery.

en-med-57.spoken: A drug-eluting stent was placed, and dual antiplatelet therapy continues with ticagrelor.

en-med-58.spoken: Her rheumatoid arthritis is in remission on methotrexate and folic acid.

en-med-59.spoken: Please recheck liver function tests, in particular the G G T and bilirubin, in four weeks.

en-med-60.spoken: The patient is discharged in improved general condition to the care of her primary care physician.
